cases.question: What is the battery life of AirPods Pro 3?
cases.actualAnswer:
From the official **AirPods Pro 3** specifications, here is the battery information:

- Up to 8 hours of listening time on a single charge with Active Noise Cancellation enabled (up to 7.5 hours with Spatial Audio and Head Tracking enabled)
- Up to 6.5 hours of listening time on a single charge with heart rate sensing during workouts
- Up to 10 hours of listening time on a single charge in Transparency using the Hearing Aid feature
- Up to 24 hours of listening time with Active Noise Cancellation enabled
- 5 minutes in the case provides around 1 hour of listening time
- MagSafe Charging Case (USB‑C) with speaker and lanyard loop

Battery life varies with settings, environment, and usage.
